text: AgentTeams Fish 是面向 DSH 的多智能体团队协作插件，适用于 Web 与可用命令入口的环境。它把团队工具、任务调度和会话提示接入宿主，并提供团队活动面板。用户可以先编排成员与依赖任务，再审批启动；成员通过持久信箱协作，队长可查看状态并处理停机、恢复和任务重派。适合需要把研究、开发或审查工作拆给多个智能体并跟踪进度的 DSH 用户。团队状态默认保存在工作区的 .agent-teams 目录。

AgentTeams Fish coordinates DSH agent teams. It connects team tools and scheduling to the host and adds an activity panel. Users can stage and approve plans, assign dependent tasks, exchange durable mailbox messages, inspect status, and reassign work. Team state defaults to .agent-teams.
我想把一个复杂目标拆成几项任务，交给不同的智能体并行做。
有没有办法先看团队计划，确认后再让多个 agent 开始工作？
让 DSH 按任务依赖顺序调度成员，前置工作完成后再派后续任务。
我需要让队长和团队成员通过收件箱持续交换任务消息。
团队任务失败后，怎么把它重新分配给其他成员继续处理？
想在 DSH 里查看成员活动、任务状态和依赖关系。
I want several agents to split a project into dependent tasks and report progress to a captain.
Can I review a team plan before its agents are started?
AgentTeams Fish 的功能「计划审批」：队长可先创建成员与任务计划并交由用户审核；收到明确批准后才启动暂存团队。
AgentTeams Fish 的功能「依赖任务调度」：调度器挑选依赖已满足的待办任务，形成成员执行提示并派发给对应成员。
AgentTeams Fish 的功能「团队信箱」：队长与成员可发送协作消息，内容会保留到收件人读取，空闲成员可被唤醒。
AgentTeams Fish 的功能「活动面板」：Web 客户端显示团队和成员活动快照，并提供会话内的团队卡片入口。

@fish-under-sea/dsh-agent-teams-fish README · 安装与兼容：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @fish-under-sea/dsh-agent-teams-fish@1.0.2
```

也由 `@fish-under-sea/dsh-fish@1.0.2` 提供，不要重复挂载。安装后重启 DSH。Node 要求 `^22.19.0 || >=24`。推荐宿主 `0.2.0-rc.2`；`0.2.1-rc.2` 为预览支持。精确支持列表以 [compatibility.json](compatibility.json) 为唯一事实源，不以桌面应用版本推断核心版本。

@fish-under-sea/dsh-agent-teams-fish README · 功能：- 先规划后审批：成员编排、任务依赖 DAG、信箱通信与进度监测。
- 持久成员、失败处理、重派能力凭据、停机与恢复，遵守宿主路由和模型白名单。
- 可选质量门：需求、实现、验证、审查、修复及集成，审查与产物绑定。
- Fish 美术：十八厂商识别，厂商与岗位头像、自定义 artworkDir、商标徽标及队长模型路由头像。缺图按“厂商+岗位 → 厂商 → 岗位”降级，不代表每个厂商都有全部岗位图。
- 新宿主预设型成员组合在子上下文安装人设和工具限制；缺失或损坏的限制在派发前拒绝。

@fish-under-sea/dsh-agent-teams-fish README · 迁移与配置：旧 npm 名 `dsh-agent-teams-fish` 改为当前 scoped 名。更新直接依赖、bundle 名和覆盖行的 `name`，保留 `id: agent-teams`；不要同时加载两个来源。状态目录默认是工作区 `.agent-teams`，memberProvider 默认 `spawn`，自定义 artworkDir 使用本机路径。配置字段与团队数据格式不因本次包名整理改变。

先安全备份再迁移。成员使用真实模型额度；工具策略由部署方声明，不能以改名绕过。不会自动修复损坏日志、删除历史事件或重发中断任务。旧会话损坏应独立诊断。

@fish-under-sea/dsh-agent-teams-fish README · 开发检查：以下命令按需手动执行。GitHub 验证仅保留手动触发，不再由 push、PR 或发布触发；标签发布直接使用已提交的构建产物，不依赖测试矩阵。已存在的 npm 版本跳过重复发布。本地 `prepublishOnly` 自动构建和验证钩子已移除，发布前是否构建与检查由维护者决定。插件运行时的权限确认与可选质量任务规则不变。

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build
pnpm verify

诊断器 `dsh-agent-teams-doctor` 只检查清单和依赖闭包，不证明运行行为或识别当前进程。真实宿主验收与 UI 检查需要另行执行。

@fish-under-sea/dsh-agent-teams-fish README · Installation and Compatibility：```sh
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add @fish-under-sea/dsh-agent-teams-fish@1.0.2
```

Also included in `@fish-under-sea/dsh-fish@1.0.2`; do not mount twice. Restart DSH after installation. Requires Node `^22.19.0 || >=24`. Recommended Host: `0.2.0-rc.2`; `0.2.1-rc.2` is preview-supported. [compatibility.json](compatibility.json) is the exact support authority; desktop and core versions are distinct.

@fish-under-sea/dsh-agent-teams-fish README · Features：- Plan and approve before execution: member orchestration, task DAGs, durable mailboxes and progress monitoring.
- Persistent members, failure handling, capability-based reassignment, stop/resume and Host-enforced route/model policies.
- Optional quality gates for requirements, implementation, verification, review, repair and integration, binding judgments to artifacts.
- Fish artwork: eighteen vendor identities, role and vendor portraits, custom artworkDir, brand marks and route-aware captain portraits. Missing art falls back vendor+role → vendor → role; not every vendor has every role.
- Preset-only Hosts receive member persona and tool restrictions inside the child context; missing or corrupt restrictions refuse dispatch.

@fish-under-sea/dsh-agent-teams-fish README · Migration and Configuration：The old unscoped npm name `dsh-agent-teams-fish` moves to this scope. Update direct dependencies, bundle names and profile override `name` values, keeping `id: agent-teams`; never load both sources. State defaults to workspace `.agent-teams`, memberProvider to `spawn`; artworkDir is machine-local. The rename does not change configuration fields or team data format.

@fish-under-sea/dsh-agent-teams-fish README · Migration and Configuration：Back up securely first. Members consume real model quota. Tool policies are deployment-owned and cannot be bypassed by renaming. The plugin does not auto-repair logs, delete historical events or replay interrupted work; diagnose old corruption separately.

@fish-under-sea/dsh-agent-teams-fish README · Development Checks：Run these commands manually as needed. GitHub verification is manual-only, never triggered by pushes, PRs or releases. Tag publishing uses committed build artifacts without the test matrix, and skips npm versions already published. The local `prepublishOnly` build/verification hook is removed; maintainers decide when to build and check. Runtime approvals and optional quality-task rules are unchanged.

```sh
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm typecheck
pnpm build
pnpm verify

@fish-under-sea/dsh-agent-teams-fish README · Development Checks：The `dsh-agent-teams-doctor` command inspects manifests and dependency closure only; it does not prove runtime behavior or identify the current process. Real Host and UI acceptance are separate.
